situation: Quantizing a modular TTS stack (AR language model + tokenizer + flow/vocoder).
decision: Quantize the autoregressive LLM first; keep the speech tokenizer, flow model, and vocoder at higher precision until perceptual tests establish safety.
reasoning_physics: The AR LM dominates memory and suffers quant least visibly; the tokenizer/vocoder are perceptual bottlenecks where artifacts are immediately audible to humans. Quantize the memory-dominant, perceptually-tolerant block first, gate the rest on A/B testing.
